pricing.alreadySubscribed: You already have an Agent subscription. Manage it in your dashboard.
pricing.faq1A: Yes. Open the Stripe Customer Portal from your dashboard and cancel in two clicks. You keep access until the end of the billing period.
pricing.faq2Q: What happens to my listings if I cancel?
pricing.faq2A: They go inactive — they stop appearing in public search but stay in your dashboard. Resubscribe and they come back instantly.
pricing.faq3Q: Do I need a separate plan for each property?
pricing.faq3A: No. The Agent plan covers up to 5 active listings. Higher caps are coming with Premium and Agency tiers.
pricing.faq4A: All major cards via Stripe Checkout, plus 3-D Secure where required by your bank.

home.leadCopy: Find homes wherever you're looking, in any market. Agents: list your properties with one click to Facebook and Instagram.
home.featuredEmpty: No listings yet — check back soon.
home.howSubheading: From listing to lead in three steps. Built for agents who don't want to hand-post to five social networks every week.
home.howStep1Body: $29 a month, 7-day free trial, cancel anytime in the Stripe Customer Portal.
home.howStep2Body: Title, photos, price, location — bilingual EN/ES. Up to 5 active listings on the Agent plan.
home.howStep3Body: Listings auto-publish to your AHO profile, the city landing page, and your social channels.
home.proSocialBody: One listing becomes Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn posts — automatically. Pro Automation handles the captions, the images, and the cross-posting so you spend more time closing deals and less time copy-pasting.
home.proSocialFeat1Body: Each network gets its own tuned post — never the same generic copy across all three.
home.proSocialFeat2Body: Connect once. Every new listing pushes to FB, IG, and LinkedIn the moment you publish.
home.proSocialFeat3Body: UTM-tagged links surface which platform sent each lead — straight in your dashboard.
